item.text: I’ll check each provider’s official pricing page and compare the current flagship model rates for input and output tokens.

arguments.code: const urls=['https://www.anthropic.com/pricing','https://openai.com/api/pricing/','https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing']; const out=await Promise.all(urls.map(async u=>{try{let r=await fetch(u);let t=await r.text();return {u,status:r.status,text:t.slice(0,2000)}}catch(e){return {u,error:String(e)}}})); nodeRepl.write(JSON.stringify(out));

item.text:
I can’t reliably compare **current** prices as of October 2026: live access to the official pricing pages failed, and my available information may be out of date. I don’t want to present stale model names or rates as current.

Here are the official pricing pages to check:

- [Anthropic API pricing](https://www.anthropic.com/pricing)
- [OpenAI API pricing](https://openai.com/api/pricing/)
- [Google Gemini API pricing](https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing)

Google’s rates can vary by context length, so compare the same input-length tier across providers.
